# schema/multi_field_cursor — valid spec; validates clean.
#
# Pre-slice-3 this file pinned the legacy extract.path namespace-shadow
# warning that fired when the body field was genuinely named "state".
# Slice 3 collapsed extract[].path/source/header into a namespace-rooted
# from: Path, so the body locator is unambiguous regardless of the
# leading body-field name and the warning is gone.

exec skopos validate -i spec.yml
! stderr .
! stdout '\bwarning\b'
! stdout '\berror\b'

-- spec.yml --
ir_version: "1"

# Multi-field cursor expressed via extract[].target: cursor.
#
# Drives a worklist API where each iteration:
#   1. Reads the previous worklist top (cursor.next_partition_id, default 0)
#      and rolling-max timestamp (cursor.last_timestamp).
#   2. Calls /api/v1/segments?partition=<id>&since=<ts>.
#   3. Captures next_partition_id (a server-supplied "where to resume") and
#      a freeze_flag boolean back into the cursor namespace.
#   4. last_timestamp is advanced by the latest_event_timestamp progress.

state:
  fields:
    url:
      type: url
      default: "http://localhost:9999"
    api_key:
      type: secret
      default: "test-bearer-token-12345"

defaults:
  base_url: {ref: state.url}

auth:
  bearer:
    token: {ref: state.api_key}

requests:
  - method: GET
    path: /api/v1/segments
    query:
      partition: {format: string, value: {ref: cursor.next_partition_id, default: 0}}
      since: {ref: cursor.last_timestamp}
    extract:
      - name: next_partition_id
        from: response.body.next_partition_id
        target: cursor
        coerce: int
      - name: freeze_flag
        # The body field is genuinely named "state". With slice 3's
        # namespace-rooted from: Path the prior namespace-shadow false-
        # positive is gone — the response.body.<...> root makes the body
        # locator unambiguous regardless of the field name underneath.
        from: response.body.state.frozen
        target: cursor
        coerce: bool

response:
  decode: json
  events_at: response.body.events

pagination:
  none: {}

progress:
  latest_event_timestamp:
    event_time:
      path: timestamp

error:
  mode: standard
